title: My read on the routing, for you to correct

elements.markdown:
Three things went wrong while building the forward-only routing.

- **The tree I write is guesswork.** I wrote an interview you answered with "all of these" twice, because my branches did not cover it.
- **I cannot see a bad branch until a user hits it.** Two conditions that overlap look fine in JSON.
- **Authoring eats tokens.** A 20-node tree is slow to emit, which is the latency the tool exists to remove.
